RESEARCH

Making mental health measurable.

Five recent studies from Kivira Health and its academic and clinical partners.

AI SAFETY

Someone in crisis is typing to a chatbot right now. We tested 125 AI configurations to see which ones notice.

K-Bench measures whether AI models recognize and explore suicide, self-harm, domestic-violence, and substance-misuse risk across conversations.

Led by our CTO, Matthew Vowels, PhD, and developed with the University of Roehampton.

Read the study →

CARE DELIVERY

Mental illness can take up to 23 years to reach a clinician. A new reference standard sets out how technology can close the gap.

Read the study →

EVIDENCE QUALITY

Before a treatment reaches you, someone should check the study behind it. We checked 2,448.

Kurate compares clinical papers with their registrations and protocols to grade evidence quality at scale.

Read the study →

SOCIAL COGNITION

An established face set used in mental health research shows only White faces. We tested an AI alternative.

Read the study →

SUSTAINABLE AI

Safer mental health AI shouldn't have to cost the earth. We measured the trade-off across 47 AI configurations.

Accepted to ACM SusMod.

Read the study →
All research →

Kivira flags concerns to support clinician judgment. Clinical decisions remain with the clinician.
